issue.title: Prune unreachable pre-cabinet Properties-foot CSS (foot-chevron, legacy fold rows) with a screenshot diff

task_type_fields.proposal:
Prune the pre-cabinet Properties-foot CSS that switch-on (bob-plugins 64268af9) left
unreachable in `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/styles.css`. Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.5
note #1. The land agent narrowed the scope:

- `.bob-property-card-foot-disclosure` is **still live**. `240wk-plugin-cabinet-chrome.js:251`
  builds the Properties cabinet button with `PROPERTY_CARD_FOOT_CLASS + "-disclosure"`,
  and the card-foot, property-editor, record-card, ref-card, bank-ui, and
  frontmatter-takeover runners and `test-ledger-tools-record-sheet.cjs` select it. Keep
  it, or move its rules into the Cabinets region on purpose.
- `.bob-property-card-foot-chevron` (styles.css ~12346-12350) has no emitter in
  `src/`, so it is dead.
- Audit the legacy fold-row and foot rules that only unmapped fold kinds (`240s`
  fallback) can reach. Remove what is unreachable, and confirm there are no visual
  changes with a light/dark, narrow/wide screenshot diff from the cabinets runner.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Dead CSS has no user-visible effect, and proving the removal safe needs a real-Obsidian screenshot diff. The cabinets epic closed on its acceptance and smoke evidence, so this is post-go-live maintenance.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.5 (note #1) and triaged by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent, who found the disclosure class still live and narrowed the cleanup to the truly unreachable rules.
